prompts.prompt:
Use case illustration-story. Paint a rich warm gouache illustration matching the TWO ORIGINAL references: visible lively brush texture, warm amber light pooling on wood, deep navy walls, layered natural lived-in coziness, rainy night. Eye level near frontal. This is a background for a search page. STRUCTURE: full-height bookcase at far left and far right edges only. Exactly TEN blank magenta portrait cases total, exactly FIVE on each bookcase, ONE case per shelf across FIVE shelves, with varied books and small ceramics alongside. Each flat unobstructed magenta rectangle #FF00FF, width:height .75, minimum 45px wide. No magenta elsewhere. Fairy-light strings on shelf edges. Do not add any more magenta cases. TOP CENTRAL WALL: completely plain blue wall from y=0 through y=.34 across central 60% landscape or y=.31 across central 56% portrait. No picture, window, hanging lamp, plant or other object crosses this area. Put rainy window entirely below this line. Keep dog large and visibly sleeping centered within y=.49–.70, all of dog and supporting bed/seat ending by y=.72. Raise room perspective floor horizon to y=.55 so dog is in the middle of image, NOT at the bottom. The lower foreground is a richly textured patterned rug for results-card overlay, furniture along its edges. All furniture normal realistic sizes, no piece wider than 42% of canvas. Exactly two to four cushions in varied fabrics, at most one solid throw, never plaid. ONE fern in a terracotta pot on a shelf and ONE rubber plant in a different ceramic pot, no vines and no other plants. Varied books, ceramics, one small abstract framed photo on furniture, tidy lived-in surfaces, nothing loose on floor. Light only from electric shaded lamps and fairy-light bulbs. NO candles, lanterns, tea lights, TV, screens, people, text, logos, titles or watermarks. No bright green. All cases at edges and fully unobstructed. Cozy dense painted warm details, not a sparse flat room.
ROOM: Compact record cabinet with turntable and a few abstract unlettered sleeves, cabinet width .25 canvas; armchair beside it, floor lamp beside armchair and a small side table within reach. Golden retriever asleep on a large soft oval fabric cushion bed IN FRONT, dog and bed centered y=.61 with bottom at .71.
FORMAT: LANDSCAPE 1536x1024. Shelf cases occupy x<.18 or x>.82.
